description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1795/16 Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette exclusively concerns the amendment of a land title registration, specifically modifying the parcel number and extent of a defined plot of land. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and directly references the Registration of Title Act, a cadastral map, and specific land parcel details. It fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4) as it deals with land registrations, property ownership, and amendments to land titles.
